spanish: Y se levantó Moisés y Josué su ministro, y subió Moisés a monte de Dios.

findings.issue: «a monte de Dios» does not mark the definiteness of the construct הַר הָאֱלֹהִים (article on הָאֱלֹהִים). The sense remains the mountain of God.

notes: Singular וַיָּקָם with Moisés y Josué, repeated Moisés on וַיַּעַל, and אלהים as Dios match the tokens.
